description.value:
Adding water to coffee powder gets you coffee. Adding water to the mixture of Stone of The Hunt and Interdimensional Leaf plus a touch of virtual particle gives you Ruby Potion!

"Ruby Potion gets you addictive to thinking fast, not to the potion itself!"

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. Speed increases by 10 feet. It also gains +1 to ability attack rolls and saving throw DCs. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

When used, increase SPD of all allies by 8%, and Effect Hit Rate by 20% for the next battle.
